summary: Tested Pantalla de Claridad backend endpoints and frontend flow end-to-end. All 4 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend loads /claridad correctly, all button onClick handlers fire, POST /api/lazo/evaluar is dispatched from the browser in both ASESORIA and AGENCIA modes, and results render as expected. The reported concern about clicks not triggering React handlers could NOT be reproduced (it was almost certainly an artifact of the screenshot tool/environment; DevTools network log shows real POST 200 responses).
critical_code_review_comments: PantallaClaridad calls axios.get(/api/lazo/dominio) once on mount but network log shows 2 GETs on load - likely React 18 StrictMode double effect in dev mode; harmless but worth being aware.

The AUTOENGANO preset in the frontend does NOT actually trigger backend autoengano flag (needs ALL 6 structural KPIs in ROJO). Instead it triggers fallo_pegado -> estado_general='TENSION', requiere_cenit=True. UI still correctly shows Cenit panel + Validar button, which matches the requested acceptance criteria (Cenit required). Consider renaming the preset or tightening the values if strict AUTOENGAÑO estado is expected.
Error handling in evaluar() only sets a generic string; consider surfacing backend error detail for debugging.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints GET /api/lazo/dominio and POST /api/lazo/evaluar are fully working. Frontend route /claridad works: sliders, presets (Nominal/Autoengaño), modo toggle (ASESORIA/AGENCIA), evaluar-btn all trigger correct behavior. Network traces confirm real POSTs from browser with 200 responses. Note: AUTOENGANO preset yields estado_general='TENSION' (fallo_pegado), not 'AUTOENGAÑO' - but Cenit UI still renders correctly as required.
